units.baseline_metrics: fresh re-extracted 2b_eval VE/inactivity/firing; decoder cosine from fixed-checkpoint training JSON
units.catalogue_active_denominator: features firing at least once across all 614400 atlas gene-token positions
units.firing_quantiles: 1st/10th/50th/90th/99th percentiles among features active across all rows
units.floors: saved rates over active gene sets, rescaled by n_catalogue_active/n_features for all-feature comparisons
units.heldout_inactive: features not firing in saved held-out evaluation positions; distinct from catalogue inactivity
units.library_comparison: full-family BH in both conditions; archival reduced library snapshot changes the tested term family, not the scorer
units.new_variant_metrics: saved six-epoch new-variant training held-out VE/inactivity and all-row firing
units.rare_firing_share: active features with frequency <1e-4 divided by all dictionary features
